'''Thomas Jones Enright''' (August 15, 1947 &ndash; January 27, 2019) was an American mathematician known for his work in the algebraic theory of [[Representation theory|representations]] of real [[Reductive group|reductive]] [[Lie group]]s.

==Biography==
Enright received a B.S. from [[Harvard University]] in 1969 and a Ph.D. in 1973 from the [[University of Washington]] under the direction of Ramesh A. Gangolli. From 1973 to 1975 he was the Hedrick Assistant Professor in [[UCLA]] working with [[Veeravalli S. Varadarajan]], and spent the 1976-1977 year after in the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] at Princeton, N. J.  before starting at [[University of California, San Diego|University of California at San Diego]] in 1977. He was chair of the mathematics department of  UCSD from 1986 to 1990.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.math.ucsd.edu/about/department-history/|title=UCSD Math {{!}} Department History|last=Support|first=Math Computing|website=www.math.ucsd.edu|access-date=2016-03-15}}</ref> In 2010 he retired due to symptoms of Parkinson's disease.

==Contributions==
In the mid-1970s, Enright introduced new methods that led him to an algebraic way of looking at [[Discrete series representation|discrete series]] (which were fundamental representations constructed by [[Harish-Chandra]] in the early 1960s), and to an algebraic proof of the [[Blattner's conjecture|Blattner multiplicity formula]].

He was known for Enright–Varadarajan modules,<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Wallach|first=Nolan R.|date=1976-01-01|title=On the Enright–Varadarajan modules: A construction of the discrete series|url=http://www.numdam.org/item/10.24033/asens.1304.pdf|journal=Annales Scientifiques de l'École Normale Supérieure |series=Série 4|language=en|volume=9|pages=81–101|issn=0012-9593|doi=10.24033/asens.1304|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.numdam.org/numdam-bin/fitem?id=CM_1978__36_1_53_0|title=Parthasarathy: A generalization of the Enright–Varadarajan modules|website=www.numdam.org|access-date=2016-04-23}}</ref> Enright resolutions, and the Enright completion [[functor]],<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=König|first1=Steffen|last2=Mazorchuk|first2=Volodymyr|date=2002-01-01|title=Enright's completions and injectively copresented modules|journal=Transactions of the American Mathematical Society|volume=354|issue=7|pages=2725–2743|doi=10.1090/S0002-9947-02-02958-6|issn=0002-9947|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Jakelić|first=Dijana|date=2007-06-01|title=On crystal bases and Enright's completions|journal=Journal of Algebra|volume=312|issue=1|pages=111–131|doi=10.1016/j.jalgebra.2006.11.045|arxiv=math/0512506|s2cid=120487}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Khomenko|first1=Oleksandr|last2=Mazorchuk|first2=Volodymyr|date=2004-10-15|title=On Arkhipov's and Enright's functors|journal=Mathematische Zeitschrift|language=en|volume=249|issue=2|pages=357–386|doi=10.1007/s00209-004-0702-8|s2cid=121941150|issn=0025-5874}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Deodhar|first=Vinay V.|date=1980-06-01|title=On a construction of representations and a problem of Enright|journal=Inventiones Mathematicae|language=en|volume=57|issue=2|pages=101–118|doi=10.1007/BF01390091|issn=0020-9910|bibcode=1980InMat..57..101D|s2cid=121286075}}</ref> which has had a lasting influence in algebra.

== Recognition ==
* Recipient of [[Alfred P. Sloan Fellowship]], 1978<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sloan.org/sloan-research-fellowships/past-fellows/?L=0%252525252525253FcHash%252525252525253D8310691d61f6bf828bef8d1badc50c0a&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Baction%5D=list&tx_sloangrants_sloanfellows%5Bcontroller%5D=Fellows&cHash=8f53adde7b4458aff6de5c2679773fee|title=Past Fellows|website=www.sloan.org|access-date=2016-03-29}}</ref>
* Enright's work was the subject of a [[Séminaire Nicolas Bourbaki|Bourbaki Seminar]] by [[Michel Duflo]]<ref>{{Cite book|last=Duflo|first=Michel|date=1979-01-01|publisher=Springer Berlin Heidelberg|isbn=9783540092438|series=Lecture Notes in Mathematics|pages=22–40|language=fr|doi=10.1007/bfb0069971|title = Séminaire Bourbaki vol. 1977/78 Exposés 507–524|volume = 710|chapter=Représentations de carré intégrable des groupes semi-simples réels|chapter-url=http://www.numdam.org/item/SB_1977-1978__20__22_0/}}</ref>
